title: Dish modifiers
description: Value stored in Dish.modifiers — an array of modifier groups (GroupModifier[]). See docs/Modifiers.md.

GroupModifier.description: A modifier group bound to a catalog Group, carrying the group-level selection rules.

id.description: restocore Group.id this modifier group points at.

rmsId.description: External RMS id of the group. May be empty for locally-created groups.

childModifiers.description: The concrete modifier options in this group.

minAmount.description: Minimum total amount the guest must select from this group. 0/null = optional.

maxAmount.description: Maximum total amount selectable. null = unlimited.

defaultAmount.description: Group-level default amount (per-child defaultAmount is preferred).

freeOfChargeAmount.description: How many picks in this group are free before charging.

isSingleModifierGroupWrapper.description: true when this group is a synthetic wrapper around a single stand-alone modifier.

modifierId.description: DEPRECATED alias — historically the group's rmsId. Use id.

Modifier.description: A single selectable modifier option — a Dish with modifier: true.

id.description: restocore Dish.id of the modifier dish.

rmsId.description: External RMS id of the modifier dish. May be empty.

minAmount.description: Minimum amount of this specific option.

maxAmount.description: Maximum amount of this specific option.

required.description: Whether this specific option must be present.

freeOfChargeAmount.description: Free quantity of this option before charging.

modifierId.description: DEPRECATED alias — historically the modifier's rmsId. Use id.
